review_description: Only one out of the 3 companies came to my house to have a look which was great, Another was pushing to get a sale but did not come and have a look at my house and wanted a me to accept his quote in 7 days which I was not keen on as I wanted to do some research. The other just contacted me over the phone as well.I also got 2 other quotes and went with one of these as they picked up that I had a 3 phase supply and that would required a different inverter.
